title: OU vs Nebraska Rivalry History and All-Time Series Record
question: What is Oklahoma's all-time football record against Nebraska?
answer: Oklahoma leads Nebraska 47-38-3 through the schools' 2022 meeting, a 49-14 OU win in Lincoln. The rivalry began in 1912, and the teams are scheduled to meet again in 2029 and 2030.
summary: OU leads Nebraska 47-38-3 through 2022. From the 1912 opener and Nebraska's 1959 upset to the 2021-22 renewal, here's the Big Red rivalry's history.
body: Long before conference realignment, Oklahoma versus Nebraska was the heartbeat of the Big Eight. Through the teams' most recent meeting in 2022, Oklahoma leads the all-time series 47-38-3.

Nebraska controlled the early decades. The Huskers won the first meeting 13-9 in Lincoln on November 23, 1912, and went 16-3-3 over the first 22 games. The two schools shared a conference from 1921 through 2010 and played 71 straight seasons from 1927 to 1997.

The tide turned under Bud Wilkinson. OU went 22-4 against Nebraska from 1943 to 1968, including 16 consecutive wins from 1943 through 1958. That made Nebraska's 25-21 win in 1959 one of the biggest upsets in the series: it ended Oklahoma's 74-game conference unbeaten streak. In the Barry Switzer era the rivalry took on national stakes, and Switzer coined the phrase Sooner Magic for OU's success in these games; he won 13 of his 18 meetings with Tom Osborne.

Realignment split the teams after Oklahoma's 23-20 win in the 2010 Big 12 Championship Game, Nebraska's last before heading to the Big Ten. The schools renewed the series with a home-and-home: OU won 23-16 in Norman in 2021 and 49-14 in Lincoln on September 17, 2022, answering Nebraska's opening touchdown with 49 straight points that began with a 61-yard Dillon Gabriel run.
Mark your calendars: the series is scheduled to continue in Norman in 2029 and in Lincoln in 2030.
